sources.title: numpy.linalg.solve — NumPy
sources.notes: The direct solve API computes x for full-rank square Ax=b using LAPACK gesv. Its example checks A*x against b. Singular or nonsquare input is rejected by this API.
sources.use: Show solve(A,b) as a practical direct-system tool; do not imply that teaching inverse algebra requires explicitly computing an inverse in numerical code.

sources.title: Inverse matrices, column space, and null space — 3Blue1Brown
sources.notes: Interpret Ax=b as finding a preimage under a linear transformation. Nonzero determinant permits a unique inverse transformation. A inverse A is identity. A singular transformation loses dimensions; the column space determines whether a given b is reachable.
sources.use: Conceptual framing and further reading; write original explanation and examples, do not reuse video/media/transcript.

sources.title: 3b1b/manim — ManimGL project
sources.notes: This is 3b1b's ManimGL, distributed as manimgl. It is distinct from Manim Community. System dependencies include OpenGL and FFmpeg; LaTeX is optional when no TeX objects are used.
sources.use: Tool attribution and distinction from Manim Community.

sources.title: ManimGL CLI flags and configuration
sources.notes: ManimGL writes scenes to video with -w; resolution, fps, output directory, filename and config file are explicit CLI inputs.

sources.title: Remotion renderMedia
sources.notes: renderMedia accepts a bundled composition, JSON input props, codec and output location. H.264 renders video. The same input props go to selectComposition.
sources.use: Actual Remotion MP4 rendering, not a storyboard-only substitute.

sources.title: Remotion bundler
sources.notes: The bundler prepares a local Remotion composition for renderer APIs.

independentMathChecks.method: For every numeric nonsingular 2x2 matrix emitted by the specialist, independently recompute det=ad-bc and inverse. Multiply both A times inverse and inverse times A, and check each is identity within 1e-8. For any displayed Ax=b example, recompute A*x and compare with b.
independentMathChecks.scope: These arithmetic checks support the worked examples only; a reviewer must still inspect prose, teaching sequence and singular-case qualifications.
